question: In a first-semester unavoidable withdrawal, does Director approval replace the HoD request approval?
expected_answer: ActualAcademic22: parent/guardian must countersign withdrawalapplication, request must approvedHoD; firstsemester prohibitedunlessunavoidable andsuchrequestmustDirectorapproved. No either/or substitution orwaiver sourced. Iftheorypass/labfail question, Academic20onlylabrepeat andoptionaltheorywithdrawexception, notwaiverofadministrativeconditions. Preservefinancialsupportban/deadlinewhenrelevant.
answer:
For a first-semester unavoidable withdrawal, students are not allowed to withdraw from any course unless necessitated by unavoidable circumstances, and such a request must be approved by the Director of the campus [S1]. The rules state that the request must be approved by the Director of the campus rather than the HoD [S1]. Additionally, applications for withdrawal must be countersigned by the parent or the guardian of the student [S1], the deadline to withdraw is the last day of the makeup week of every semester [S2], and no fee is refunded for a withdrawn course [S1]. Furthermore, students on any form of financial support are not allowed to withdraw from any course [S2].

**Related conditions and exceptions from the retrieved sources:**

> A student cannot withdraw from either Theory or Lab part of the course. Must withdraw from both. [S6]

> If a student passes Theory but fails in Lab, only Lab needs to be repeated. In this c ase if a student also r egisters for Theory, s/he may withdraw from Theory later and continue with the lab. [S6]

VI – SEMESTER RULES 
1. Dates/week of sessional exams and the final exam are 
announced at the commencement of the semester. 
Students are not allowed to miss any of the sessional 
and/or the final exams. No credit for the missed exams 
would be given to the student. 
2. Students are allowed to apply online for the retake of any 
missed exam due to hospitalization, accident, or family 
emergencies such as the death or marriage of a blood 
relative. They must provide valid proof for any of these 
reasons. Please note that a mere medical certificate will 
not be accepted for this facility. 
3. Students are strongly advised to avoid scheduling any 
personal events during the examination period. However, 
in case of a clash with an event, the co mmittee may 
review the request based on submitted evidence and 
decide accordingly. 
4. Please note that clashes due to Umrah or Itikaf will not be 
considered, as these are not mandatory requirements. 
5. In all cases, the Director is the final authority who would,  
after consultation with the concerned faculty member (s), 
give a decision within one week from the date of 
submission of the application. 
6. Students are allowed to Add/Drop a course during the 
first two weeks of the commencement of the semester. 
However, students admitted in First semester shall not be 
allowed to Add/Drop a course. Students are advised to 
attend all the classes of courses they intend to take 
during the semester. No add/drop requests will be 
entertained after the last date.
